rule_or_step_title: Absence of Seizures in Loss-of-Function Alleles
matching_criterion_description: Epileptic seizures were entirely absent in patients carrying loss-of-function truncating alleles; presence of early-onset refractory seizures argues strongly against a simple haploinsufficient LoF variant.
Sensorineural hearing loss is not a defining human phenotype in monoallelic DHX9 cohorts and should not be used as an inclusion criterion.
